Context: 7. Annual Performance Assessment Reports (APARs)

## 7. Annual Performance Assessment Reports (APARs)  
1. Purpose and importance.APARs is an objective assessment of the work and conduct of a Government servant. Assessment of APARs is the main criteria for Confirmation, Promotion, Review under FR 56 (j) for premature retirement, etc. Writing and maintenance of APARs, therefore, assumes importance, not only in the interest of service but also in the interest of the employee.
